text: That is unexpected; the High-Resolution CT showing normal readings contradicts the initial X-ray findings of interstitial markings. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor

text: The normal sputum cytology and persistent obstruction despite normal CT and FeNO are unusual. Have you ever experienced a "smoker's cough" or been exposed to significant secondhand smoke, and do you have a history of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)? REQUEST TEST: 24-Hour pH_Study
